finding: F6B-03; planning/reviews/F2-06-recheck-02.md (F6B-03, PARTIAL) and planning/F2/07-repair-names-contract.md (F6B-03, owed)
case: The RIGHT operand of the checker-identity equality is repointed from the calibration to the subject, so the guard compares the checker_id of the interval with itself. Both pinned pointers stay in the body and every op name and type is unchanged.
why: An equality that is true of every interval admits an acceptance whose calibration belongs to a different checker, which is exactly the state F6B-03 reported: calibration_ref bound the acceptance to A calibration at run and to no particular instrument. The mutation is chosen to leave the PIN satisfied -- the pin row asks that the conjunct mention /payload/checker_id and cannot say which record each side reads, and it says so about itself -- so what refuses this fixture is the structural comparison in validate_contracts.py and nothing else. That is F6Y-02 measured against the check written in its shadow, the same way R44 measures it.
expect_failure_contains: A VERDICT MAY BE ACCEPTED ON A CALIBRATION BOUND TO ANOTHER CHECKER
